name: Claus' Secret Surprise
source:
It's time to find out what this Christmas has in store for you!

You are the regional manager of the Holiday Cooperative and have been given the task of changing the North Pole toy factory to produce only naughty toys 😉🥵. Will you be able to complete this mission in time?

This is your chance to have some fun with Mrs. Claus and all the other girls at the toy factory, in this special short game. The weather may be cold, but things are going to heat up this Christmas!!!🎄⛄

[From [url=https://run-666.itch.io/claus-secret-surprise]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
是时候看看这个圣诞节为你准备了什么！

你是假日合作社的区域经理，接到的任务是把北极玩具工厂改为只生产淘气玩具😉🥵。你能及时完成这个任务吗？

这是你在这个特殊的短游戏中与克劳斯夫人和玩具工厂的所有其他女孩一起玩耍的机会。天气可能很冷，但今年圣诞节一切都会升温！！！🎄⛄

[来自[url=https://run-666.itch.io/claus-secret-surprise]itch.io[/url]]
